requirement:
调整通知服务和订单管理的数据处理逻辑。
通知服务发送消息时数据格式有误，导致订单服务接收失败。
需要修正通知和订单服务之间的数据格式约定。

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service receives notifications and is directly affected by the data format mismatch.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Alternative order service may also consume notifications and share similar data format dependencies.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to preserve service, may interact with notification data flow.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Cancellation flows may send notifications and rely on consistent data format.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: Preserve service may trigger notifications and could be impacted by format changes.

details.name: ts-rebook-service
details.rationale: Rebooking operations may involve notifications and order updates.

details.name: ts-execute-service
details.rationale: Execution service may send notifications for order status changes.

details.name: ts-admin-order-service
details.rationale: Admin order service may display or process notifications related to orders.
